batch-grouped review navigation: target select grouped via optgroups per labeling batch (8a / 9a; task / set in the group label) + "batch <id> · set · task" chip on the record header; named check executed in the browser smoke (batched generation reads like its generation); screenshot regenerated

sticky reviewer initials (localStorage per session, pre-fills every target) + per-batch decided/total progress on the optgroup label (renderTargetStatus-driven, agents and reviewers see batch progress without the tracker); browser smoke strengthened and PASS

bulk "Accept verified in batch": one click ACCEPTs the batch's undecided targets that already passed the automated source checks with the reviewer's remembered initials (one decision per (document, field), still a human save) — the agent accelerates and the human countersigns; /api/contract rule added; batch progress label reflects decisions live (asserted 1/1 after the bulk flow); browser smoke PASS with the flow screenshot

tabbed page: batch launcher / label review / campaign tracker as separate tab views (one visible at a time, aria tablist + tabpanel, localStorage-remembered choice, launcher tab gets an availability badge when the server un-gates the panel) — the single scrolling page no longer buries review under launch + tracker; new named check 'launcher / review / tracker tab switching'; browser smoke PASS

ARIA tabs keyboard pattern on the tab bar: Left/Right cycle selection, Home/End jump, focus follows the selection, roving tabindex keeps only the active tab in the tab order, and each arrow keydown preventDefaults so the page-level 'N' shortcut can't fire from tabs; named checks 'tab keyboard: arrow/home/end with roving tabindex'; browser smoke PASS

full a11y pass folded in: one <main> landmark, <header>-wrapped h1 (kills landmark-one-main + 5 stray 'region' findings), axe-core 4.10.2 scan wired into the browser smoke behind AXE_PATH (evidence axe.json: violations [] x passes 39, wcag2a+aa+best-practice); permanent named check 'single main landmark, headered page, labelled tab panels' (arity + aria-controls targets + exactly one selected tab); verify_interface.sh now keeps node.out in evidence and prints the failing tail instead of swallowing the smoke's stderr

batch-scoped next pending: 'Next pending in batch' button + Shift+N keyboard (stays inside the cursor batch, falls back to the global scan when the batch is fully decided) + static keyboard legend under the toolbar; named check 'batch-scoped next pending and keyboard legend' asserts the staying-vs-global discrimination with decision snapshots restored; browser smoke PASS

'Jump to batch' select next to the target list: mirrors the batch optgroups with live pending/total counts, choosing one lands on that batch's first pending target (fully-decided batches stay put); rebuilt with the batch progress labels on every decision change; named check 'batch jump select navigates to a batch first pending' (decision snapshots restored); browser smoke PASS
